basinQualification.reason: Dussaux firsthand visit p289 places depolluting planted basins at the end of Jardin des origines, immediately before Grande Halle. Official 2009 illustrated map depicts the unique parallel rectangular ponds precisely there, beside the theatre. BASE plan confirms that arrangement. BASE photographs 08/12/13 show matching dark rectangular pond rims, grass walkways and planted water; 08/13 also show the adjacent theatre site and its scaffold towers. The separate dew-garden water is naturalistic and crossed by timber footbridges, excluded from this identification.
basinQualification.limits: No species, filtering-performance claim, date or GPS coordinate inferred from the photographs. Different seasonal states retained without assigning dates.
